nodes.name: power_9v_boost
nodes.description: MT3608 boost converter generates VCC_9V from VIN_5V for NE5532 preamplifier. EN pin enables converter (tie to VIN for always-on). FB pin requires external feedback divider network (added in downstream wiring) to set 9V output. SW pin connects to boost inductor and diode network. This module is the sole provider of VCC_9V rail.

nodes.name: SW

nodes.name: EN

nodes.name: VIN
nodes.description: Input supply pin, operating range 2V-24V, must be locally bypassed with capacitor

nodes.name: NC

nodes.name: power_3v3_ldo
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO generates VCC_3V3 from VIN_5V for ATmega328P and MCP4725. Always-on configuration (no external enable control). Input and output require bypass capacitors (added in downstream wiring). This module is the sole provider of VCC_3V3 rail.

nodes.name: mcu
nodes.description: ATmega328P MCU controls system operation. Powered by VCC_3V3 on VCC and AVCC pins. AREF can be tied to VCC_3V3 or external reference. I2C interface (PC4=SDA, PC5=SCL) acts as master to MCP4725 DAC. Internal 8MHz oscillator or external crystal configuration to be determined. BOOT and reset pins require appropriate pull-up/pull-down networks (added in downstream wiring).

nodes.name: dac_control
nodes.description: MCP4725 12-bit I2C DAC provides analog gain control voltage to NE5532 preamplifier. Powered by VCC_3V3. I2C slave address configured via A0 pin (tie to GND or VDD for address selection). VOUT pin outputs DAC voltage that feeds preamp gain-control/bias network (passive network added in downstream wiring). I2C pull-up resistors to be placed in MCU module.

nodes.name: VOUT
nodes.description: DAC analog output, rail-to-rail (0 to VDD).

nodes.name: VDD
nodes.description: Supply voltage (2.7-5.5V), also serves as DAC reference.

nodes.name: SDA
nodes.description: I2C data, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: SCL
nodes.description: I2C clock, open-drain. Requires external pull-up on bus.

nodes.name: A0
nodes.description: I2C address bit. VSS=0x60, VDD=0x61. Must not float.

nodes.name: preamp_stereo
nodes.description: NE5532 dual low-noise op-amp provides stereo preamplification stage. Powered by VCC_9V on VCC_P (pin 8) and GND on VCC_N (pin 4). Channel 1 (pins 1-3) handles left audio, Channel 2 (pins 5-7) handles right audio. Gain control/bias input receives MCP4725 VOUT through passive network (added in downstream wiring) - this enables voltage-controlled gain or bias adjustment. OUT1 and OUT2 feed PAM8403 INL and INR respectively. Analog ground routing should converge at star point.

nodes.name: power_amp_stereo
nodes.description: PAM8403 3W stereo Class-D amplifier drives speakers. PVDD_1, PVDD_2, and VDD powered directly by VIN_5V. INL receives left channel from preamp, INR receives right channel from preamp. MUTE and SHDN pins require configuration (tie to VDD for normal operation or GPIO control). VREF pin sets internal reference (bypass cap to GND). OUT_L_P/N and OUT_R_P/N are differential speaker outputs (board-level connectors added in downstream wiring). PGND_1 and PGND_2 are power grounds that should route to star ground point.
